canonical_schema_owner: C; this is B's compatible contribution, not a replacement benchmark registry

shared_measure_contract.known_zero: A known zero numerator over positive qualified denominator equals zero. Zero denominator stays undefined. Unknown annotation is not false or DNP.
shared_measure_contract.uncertainty: Empirical-Bayes beta intervals summarize the declared pseudo-count construction, conditional on shared estimates. They do not account for all football dependence or establish predictive coverage.

QB_sections.attempts: Official credited nonsack/nontwopoint pass attempts, separate from dropbacks; own last8 eligible appearances; existing frozen gamma-Poisson exposure law.
QB_sections.contexts: 25 exhaustive down/depth cells: down1/2/3/4/UNKNOWN x attempted air-yards <0,0-to-<10,10-to-<20,20+,UNKNOWN. Frequencies divide context attempts by all own attempts; conditional completions divide by context attempts. No target-game context is consumed.
QB_sections.shrunk_context: Own context mix=(own count+20*earlier league mix)/(own attempts+20); completion=(own completions+selected strength20*earlier pooled rate)/(own context attempts+20). These are the accepted model's existing estimates.
QB_sections.field_context: Earlier throw-weighted means and observation denominators for distance-to-go,yardline100,game seconds remaining and score differential. These do not forecast future game script.
QB_sections.opponent_context: Last16 eligible opponent games. For each context: (observed completions-earlier offense-adjusted expected completions)/(attempts+100), plus own mix times that context-specific residual. Not pure defensive talent.
QB_sections.charted_depth_annotations: Provider catchable/drop/contested flags use separate known-annotation denominators by depth. No completion/catchability/drop accounting identity is assumed. If mapping is absent, this section is UNAVAILABLE_SOURCE, not copied from aggregate flags.
QB_sections.pass_destination: Earlier thrown-ball left/middle/right/UNKNOWN counts under the source contract. Not receiver alignment and no newly authenticated field orientation.
QB_sections.role_stint: Supplied historical QB role/team only; starter, limited, replacement and designed-dropback stint probabilities remain unmodeled.
QB_sections.dropbacks: Unavailable from the accepted retained game-input schema; absence here is not a claim that public PBP cannot support a separately qualified transformation.

other_roles.RB: A-owned direction/gap/down/distance, team-run/share and conditional signed-yard/success profiles; B does not duplicate.
other_roles.WR_TE: C-owned targeting/depth/QB-pair/qualified alignment-route-separation profiles; B does not infer alignment from destination or routes from snaps.

future_query_contract.target_outcomes: Not required or read. No target-game statistical row selects future membership.
future_query_contract.limitations: Structural validation of supplied evidence does not independently authenticate a roster or historical source. No live query universe or consumer admission is claimed by this profile export.
